title: 航空構造設計Ⅱ
subtitle: Aircraft Structure Design II
educationalGoal: Students will learn (1) how to analyze the buckling load of thin flat plate (2) the concept of effective width flat plate with stiffeners (3) mechanics of composite lamina (4) mechanics of composite laminate
advice: On the basis of knowledge learned in subjects such as Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure, student will learn the advanced mechanics for aircraft structural design. We will cover the following materials: (1) Buckling of thin flat plate (2) Buckling and effective width of plate with stiffeners (3) Mechanics of composite lamina (4) Mechanics of composite laminate Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure before taking this course.
books: Basis of Understanding Strength of Materials -Second Edition, Kyoritsu Syuppan, 2013
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate buckling load of thin flat plates
Be able to understand the concept of effective width and calculate the effective width of plate with stiffeners
Be able to calculate the stiffness matrix of composite lamina and explain the mechanical behavior
Be able to calculate the coordinate-transformed stiffness matrix of composite lamina
Be able to calculate the stiffness matrix of composite laminates and explain the mechanical behavior
